blocks.content: Here is an example of infinite recursion with arguments.
Here, we have called the printNumbers() method with 100 as an argument. The method prints the value and calls itself recursively with the same value n as argument.
Now, let's look at what happens during each recursive call.

items: The printNumbers() method is called again with 100 as an argument.
n is 100 again, which is printed.
The printNumbers() method is called again with 100 as an argument.

blocks.content: Essentially, this program will run continuously with 100 as an argument in each method call.
Next, we will modify this program so the value of the argument is changed with each recursive call.
